title: Caida Sistema Seguridad Sysmac NX
technician_version: Omron Sysmac NX distributed system, 7 EtherCAT NX nodes across a plant. Nodes 1-6 carry safety I/O (NX-SID800, NX-SID400, NX-SOH200) under an NX-SL3300 safety CPU; node 7 has only standard digital/analog I/O and nothing safety-related in its program. When node 7 loses power, the whole safety system (SL3300 plus all safety cards) trips with a safety-system failure alarm and the plant stops. Losing node 7's EtherCAT comms alone does NOT trip safety (they got that to ride through and auto-recover), but loss of power to node 7 always does. How do I make a power loss on the non-safety node drop only that node without taking down the safety system? Ongoing for over a year.
model: Sysmac NX, NX-SL3300, NX-SID800, NX-SID400, NX-SOH200, EtherCAT coupler nodes
fault_symptom: Power loss on non-safety EtherCAT node trips entire NX-SL3300 safety system; comm loss alone does not
